success.title: Post Revisions is Normal
success.details: Your site has {size} post revisions, which is within acceptable limits. Post revisions are used to track changes to posts, but too many can impact database performance.
steps: Keep minimal revisions for important posts
Consider using a revision control plugin
We recommend using plugins like WP-Optimize, Advanced Database Cleaner, or WP-DBManager, just to name a few.

error.title: Post Revisions are High
error.details: Your site has {size} post revisions, which may impact database performance.
steps: Consider disabling revisions for certain post types

learn_more.description: WordPress stores a copy of each saved draft as a revision. While this helps track changes, too many revisions can bloat your database.
